input.prompt: Locked wide camera, candid real-time street footage, normal 24 fps playback. This accident is SUDDEN and startles both unsuspecting men. Begin exactly with the first image. They are looking at the delivery, relaxed; neither looks upward nor follows the falling object. Its visible descent takes only a blink, approximately 0.25 seconds, with strong vertical motion blur. Gravity accelerates it straight DOWN, keyboard horizontal and facing the camera. No gentle landing. The hard collision is one immediate physical event: cup cartons and bread crates collapse as the PIANO ITSELF breaks apart under its weight. Its wooden cabinet buckles and splits, broad front and top panels tear loose, the keyboard snaps, a few keys and wooden splinters scatter, and its heavy internal frame collapses downward into the low wreckage shown by the last image. No explosion, no fire, no bouncing intact piano. At the instant of the loud CRASH, both men involuntarily jolt backward, duck their shoulders and throw their hands up in surprise. The worker recoils toward his truck; the owner flinches back into his doorway. They react to the impact rather than anticipating or tracking the fall. Both remain unharmed and clear of all debris. Cups, bread and small fragments scatter briefly, fall fast and stop; the main heavy wooden pieces drop close to the wreck. Finish all violent motion within the first 1.5 seconds, then let the stunned men slowly lower their hands and stare at the broken piano in disbelief. Final image is the settled aftermath, not a target to delay the crash until. Sound: one abrupt heavy crash exactly on impact, splintering timber and clattering broken piano keys, a short discordant clang, then street ambience.
